source_documents.title: ASF Synthetic Aperture Radar Product User Guide: SENTINEL-1 Bursts SAR Data Products

processing_chain: SENTINEL-1A/1B/1C/1D_SLC (L1): ESA IW/EW SLC SAFE products in ASF's archive
ASF Burst Extractor (on request): reads one burst (burst_index) of one sub-swath x polarization measurement TIFF, plus annotation
SENTINEL-1_BURSTS (L1): one granule per burst x polarization; GeoTIFF / XML / SAFE-ZIP, named by ESA Burst ID
Downstream (not CMR collections): HyP3-ISCE2 burst InSAR products

depth_2.note: Each SLC parent is an ESA Level-1 product made by the IPF from the same platform's Level-0 data (SENTINEL-1x_RAW); see the SENTINEL-1C_DP_GRD_HIGH notebook. No SLC record links an ATBD or a PARENT. SLC <- RAW is the parents' lineage, not the target's (rule 1c-1), so no depth-2 rows are written.

relationships.evidence_quote: The Sentinel-1 Burst Extractor allows users to download a single burst from the Sentinel-1 SLC without having to download the entire SLC that contains it.
relationships.rationale: Decision step 2: each burst granule is a subset of one Sentinel-1A SLC product's data, unchanged (PARENT; the record currently says INPUT). Generic "the Sentinel-1 SLC" mapped to the platform ShortName; confirmed by Sentinel-1A SLC names in granule InputGranules (Step 6c).

supporting_evidence.quote: The granule metadata describes the burst and provides links to a service which extracts the burst image from the SLC product and returns a GeoTIFF file.
INPUT SENTINEL-1A_SLC: This dataset contains the original Sentinel-1A Single Look Complex scenes which are used to create the granules in this collection.

relationships.evidence_quote: RelativeBurstId = Burst ID values assigned by ESA, each value identifies a burst cycle, within each sub-swath the burst ID values are unique.
relationships.rationale: Granule names and BURST_ID_* attributes use ESA Burst IDs, which the Burst ID map ties to footprints. There is no data dependency, so this is related_to rather than INPUT.

supporting_evidence.quote: The Burst ID map is a complementary auxiliary product.

metadata_findings: The SLC collections are recorded as INPUT; by the PARENT vs INPUT test they are PARENT (bursts are the SLC data, subset).
Two association EntryIds are misspelled and do not resolve in CMR: SENIINEL-1C_SLC and SENIINEL-1D_SLC.
Platforms check: all input platforms are listed.

The Burst User Guide describes only Sentinel-1A/1B/1C (launch list) and has no product-generation content; the Burst Extractor documentation, which does, is linked only from granules, not from the collection.
No ATBD is linked; the Burst Extractor documentation could be added as a collection-level related URL.

processing_chain: SENTINEL-1A/1B_SLC (L1): reference + secondary IW SLC scenes (InputGranules)
ARIA topsApp PGE (ISCE2 topsApp, ariamh / topsApp_pge): coregistration, interferogram, filtering, unwrapping, geocoding
Superseded by ARIA_S1_GUNW (v3.x, DockerizedTopsApp, fixed ARIA frames), reprocessed from SLCs

depth_2.note: Each SLC parent is an ESA Level-1 product made by the IPF from the same platform's Level-0 data (SENTINEL-1x_RAW); see the SENTINEL-1C_DP_GRD_HIGH notebook. relationships.evidence_document: ASF HyP3: ARIA Sentinel-1 GUNW Product Guide
relationships.evidence_quote: the ARIA processing code takes a list of reference and secondary Sentinel-1 IW SLC granules as input
relationships.rationale: Decision step 2: the v2 interferograms are Sentinel-1A SLC pairs processed by the ARIA topsApp PGE (PARENT). Generic "Sentinel-1 IW SLC" mapped to the platform ShortName; confirmed by Sentinel-1A SLC names in granule InputGranules (Step 6b).

supporting_evidence.quote: generating an ARIA Sentinel-1 Geocoded Unwrapped Interferogram (ARIA-S1-GUNW) product from a collection of valid Sentinel-1 IW-mode Single Look Complex (SLC) IDs across a date pair using ISCE2
These products were first generated using the topsApp Product Generation Executable (PGE) written by Mohammed Karim and David Bekaert in the ariamh repo.

relationships.evidence_quote: This dataset contains an updated version of the Sentinel-1 geocoded unwrapped interferograms produced by the ARIA project.
relationships.rationale: Decision step 6: a different ShortName holding the successor (v3.x) versions of the same ARIA GUNW product family (version_of). Not a CHILD: v3 GUNWs are reprocessed from SLCs, not made from these v2 products (ARIA_S1_GUNW InputGranules are SLCs). The current record labels it SCIENCE ASSOCIATED.

supporting_evidence.quote: This dataset contains earlier versions of the Sentinel-1 geocoded unwrapped interferograms produced by the ARIA project.
Since v3+, in addition to reference and secondary scenes, a `frame-id` must be supplied for a *standard* product to be generated.
